title: The benchmark pool's answer regexes miss capitalised durations, take 0.1 hour, and reject the mcp__server__* and mcp__server rule forms
goal: The answer regexes of the six cmpivot timeout rows (BP-d306eaa8, BP-8f566d80, BP-70d0bf39, BP-b124a0c0, BP-1f52a1d6, BP-6ca01fa4) and of BP-c552cb0f match as agent_bench scores them (re.search with no flags): they take a capitalised 'Ten minutes', 'One hour' or 'Cannot block termination' and reject '0.1 hour'; the answer regex of sc_stale row BP-43472201 (bench_scenarios.csv and bench_pool.csv, in step) matches mcp__server__* and mcp__server as permissions-mcp.md:44 states, besides mcp__server__tool; and pool check passes
